CORRECTION_OF_MY_OWN_PRIOR_CLAIM.why_the_equivalence_holds: A transverse Mercator with latitude of origin 0, central meridian 9 degrees east (the UTM zone 32 central meridian), scale factor 0.9996 (the UTM scale factor), false easting 500000 and false northing 0 on WGS84 is precisely the definition of UTM zone 32N. The verbose tmerc spelling and the compact +proj=utm +zone=32 spelling denote the same projection.
CORRECTION_OF_MY_OWN_PRIOR_CLAIM.lesson_recorded: Text-form comparison is not a valid equivalence test. PROJ normalises the verbose form to the UTM form on round-trip. Any prior reasoning in this session that treated the label as suspect on the basis of its proj4 spelling was reasoning from surface form and is retracted.
